question: Was the Central line between Liverpool Street and Bethnal Green ground to reduce noise, and when?
norm_question: was the central line between liverpool street and bethnal green ground to reduce noise and when

answer.text: According to the Mayor's answer to Question 2022/1791, Central line Bethnal Green to Liverpool Street benefited from rail grinding to help reduce noise between December 2021 and May 2022, while Liverpool Street to Bethnal Green is not listed.

verified_claims.text: According to the spreadsheet attached to the Mayor's written answer to Question 2022/1791 on 28 June 2022, the Central line section from Bethnal Green to Liverpool Street benefited from rail grinding to help reduce noise levels between December 2021 and May 2022.

citations.quote: The requested information is in the attached spreadsheet.
Sections of the London Underground that have benefited from rail grinding to help reduce noise levels (December 2021-May 2022)

verified_claims.text: The spreadsheet attached to the Mayor's answer to Question 2022/1791 does not list the opposite direction, Liverpool Street to Bethnal Green, among sections ground between December 2021 and May 2022, and its provisional list for June 2022 to November 2022 lists only Queensway to Lancaster Gate on the Central line.
